# The code tree this corpus was written against, one repo-relative path per
# line. Materialised by the test rather than committed, because these are
# source-file NAMES and nothing else: `propose_map` matches a section title
# against directory names and ranks top-level directories by file count, so
# the contents are irrelevant — while committing stub `.py` files would put
# them inside the suite's own preference scans, where they are not code
# anyone wrote and cannot honestly answer for.
